jobs.title: Digital Enablement Analyst
jobs.description:
At AIG, we are reimagining the way we help customers to manage risk. Join us as a Digital Enablement Analyst to play your part in the transformation. It’s an opportunity to grow your skills and experience as a valued member of the team.

**Make your mark in Digital Enablement**

As part of AIG’s Digital and Direct Marketing team, the Digital Enablement team is at the forefront of shaping how we connect with our customers online. We drive strategy and deliver solutions that strengthen customer interaction, boost engagement and improve conversion. By combining digital capabilities with direct marketing expertise, we create intuitive, user-friendly experiences that make it easier for consumers to understand, access and benefit from our solutions.

**How you will create an impact**

Sitting at the intersection of business, technology and design, you will be responsible for driving the development and optimisation of digital experiences and enablement initiatives that address market needs while creating viable business opportunities. Acting as the voice of the customer, you will leverage a deep understanding of customer interactions, analytics and user insights to recommend, design and implement solutions that drive success across platforms.

This role requires both strategic insight and executional focus, balancing an appreciation of existing processes with the ability to identify enablement opportunities, analyze performance trends, and deliver innovative solutions that achieve business goals.

Key accountabilities would include:

**Digital Product Management**

* Own digital projects and drive end-to-end delivery to enhance operational efficiency, capture business opportunities and elevate user experience
* Develop a deep understanding of consumers’ needs to drive the success of AIG’s digital experience and product offerings
* Analyze market trends, competitor landscape, customer behaviour, to form an outside-in perspective
* Translate business and customer requirements into user stories, product specifications, wireframes and development requirements
* Work closely with relevant stakeholders on the development, QA, UAT, release, and market launch of products
* Conduct usability reviews and support user testing activities to identify enhancement opportunities
* Develop and execute adoption, communication and change management strategies to maximise the uptake and effectiveness of digital solutions internally and externally.
* Collaborate across functions, including insurance product teams, IT, marketing, customer insights, customer service, finance, claims, legal, corporate communications, to deliver products that meet consumers’ needs
* Maintain good stakeholder communications on project goals, requirements, timelines, status, risks and key milestones

**Design and Prototyping**

* Partner with developers and business stakeholders to iterate and improve digital experiences
* Create wireframes, clickable prototypes, user flows and customer journey maps using Figma to communicate requirements and validate solutions with stakeholders.
* Maintain design system standards and ensure consistency across digital touchpoints where applicable

**Performance Tracking and Optimisation**

* Define and monitor success metrics, KPIs and reporting frameworks for digital products and journeys
* Analyze digital performance metrics, customer behavior and feedback to identify optimisation opportunities that improve conversions, user growth, retention and engagement
* Establish and maintain end-to-end online journey tracking, dashboards and reporting
* Utilise digital analytics, customer journey and experimentation tools to identify opportunities, measure outcomes and improve digital performance metrics.
* Develop reports and presentations that translate digital insights into actionable business recommendations
* Support A/B testing, experimentation frameworks and data-driven optimisation initiatives

**Digital Tools and Asset Management**

* Manage website content and champion change requests
* Manage email marketing platform and support external communications
* Create product strategy documents and business cases to illustrate use cases and ROI

**What you’ll need to succeed**

* 3-5 years working experience in product management, digital, or related roles
* Strong understanding and appreciation of a customer’s digital journey
* Prior experience and proficiency in the use of tools (software, platforms, systems, applications, or solutions) for CMS, project management, UI/UX, prototyping and web analytics
* Hands-on experience using Figma for wireframing, prototyping, user flows, customer journey mapping and stakeholder collaboration, with the ability to translate business requirements into experience designs.
* Knowledge of design systems, UI/UX best practices, and responsive design concepts
* Proficiency in research and analysis with a keen interest in data analysis
* Highly focused and creative thinker who is enthusiastic about making objective decisions based on evidence and data while balancing business goals
* Self-motivated and directed with the ability to work both autonomously as well as in collaboration with other stakeholders
* Strong business acumen and clarity of mind to navigate constraints and solve complex problems
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to convey complex information and manage both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Strong written and oral communication skills

At AIG, we value in-person collaboration as a vital part of our culture, which is why we ask our team members to be primarily in the office. This approach helps us work together effectively and create a supportive, connected environment for our team and clients alike.

**Enjoy benefits that take care of what matters**

At AIG, our people are our greatest asset. We know how important it is to protect and invest in what’s most important to you. That is why we created our Total Rewards Program, a comprehensive benefits package that extends beyond time spent at work to offer benefits focused on your health, wellbeing and financial security—as well as your professional development—to bring peace of mind to you and your family.

**Reimagining insurance to make a bigger difference to the world**

American International Group, Inc. (AIG) is a global leader in commercial and personal insurance solutions; we are one of the world’s most far-reaching property casualty networks. It is an exciting time to join us — across our operations, we are thinking in new and innovative ways to deliver ever-better solutions to our customers. At AIG, you can go further to support individuals, businesses, and communities, helping them to manage risk, respond to times of uncertainty and discover new potential. We invest in our largest asset, our people, through continuous learning and development, in a culture that celebrates everyone for who they are and what they want to become.

**Welcome to a culture of** **inclusion**

We’re committed to creating a culture that truly respects and celebrates each other’s talents, backgrounds, cultures, opinions and goals. We foster a culture of inclusion and belonging through learning, cultural awareness activities and Employee Resource Groups (ERGs). With global chapters, ERGs are a cornerstone for our culture of inclusion. The talent of our people is one of AIG’s greatest assets, and we are honored that our drive for positive change has been recognized by numerous recent awards and accreditations.

jobs.description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

  
  
  

**Group/Division**

KLA's Global Supply Chain (GSC) oversees sourcing, supplier contracting and management, materials management, direct and indirect procurement, and logistics and trade compliance. GSC leads activities to establish and manage an innovative, reliable, efficient, effective and compliant global supply chain and logistics structure that strengthens KLA's competitive advantage.

**What You'll Do**

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Financial Business Partnering & Supply Chain Finance (** **Essential** **)**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### **A. FP&A Ownership & Financial Planning**

* Handle global manufacturing warehousing financial performance across actuals, forecasts, budgets, and strategic planning cycles.
* Perform detailed variance analysis against budget, forecast, prior year, and strategic plan assumptions.
* Lead forecasting and planning activities, incorporating operational assumptions and input from business partners.
* Build and maintain financial models to support budgeting, forecasting, scenario planning, and case evaluations.

### **B. Logistics Finance & Cost Management**

* Develop a strong understanding of global manufacturing warehousing operations and related logistics activities, including warehousing, distribution, transportation, fulfillment, and the associated financial and operational cost drivers.
* Support month-end and quarter-end close activities and logistics financial governance processes, including accrual reviews, invoice validation, purchase order monitoring, cost reallocations, financial controls, reporting, and management reviews.
* Develop, maintain, and lead cost allocation methodologies for manufacturing warehousing and shared logistics expenses across business divisions.
* Support investment decisions and projects related to manufacturing warehousing operations, capacity planning, and logistics network optimization.

### **C. Business Partnering & Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as the primary finance business partner for KLA's global manufacturing warehousing operations.
* Partner closely with manufacturing warehousing operations, logistics teams, procurement, and regional finance organizations to analyze operational and financial performance, understand cost drivers, and recommend ways to improve cost efficiency and service performance.
* Prepare executive-level reporting, presentations, and financial commentary that support sound financial decisions and accountability across manufacturing warehousing and logistics organizations.

### **D. Continuous Improvement & Transformation**

* Simplify, standardize, and automate logistics finance processes to improve efficiency, reporting quality, and scalability.

**Data Analytics & Digital Insights (Preferred)**
-------------------------------------------------

* Use Snowflake, Power BI, and other enterprise data platforms to analyze large and sophisticated datasets, identify trends, risks, and opportunities, and support business reporting and financial analysis.
* Build and maintain reporting datasets, dashboards, and management reporting solutions while partnering with Digital Solutions, Finance, and Operations teams to improve data quality and reporting capabilities.
* Translate sophisticated analytical findings into actionable recommendations and support data-driven decision making through reporting automation and business intelligence solutions.

**AI & Process Automation (Preferred)**
---------------------------------------

* Leverage AI-enabled tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Cowork, and other approved enterprise AI platforms to improve efficiency and business outcomes.
* Support automation initiatives that streamline reporting, forecasting, and financial analysis processes.
* Support the adoption of AI tools and effective ways of working as part of the company's digital transformation efforts.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Experience supporting manufacturing warehousing, logistics, manufacturing operations, or supply chain finance organizations.
* Proven understanding of manufacturing warehousing operations, warehouse cost drivers, and logistics processes.

**Experience with:**
--------------------

* Power BI
* Snowflake
* SAP
* Power Query
* OneStream, TM1, Essbase or other planning systems
* Experience building executive dashboards, financial models, and automated reporting solutions.
* Exposure to AI-enabled efficiency tools and process automation technologies.

**Minimum Qualifications**

**Minimum Qualifications**
==========================

* Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Supply Chain, Analytics, or a related field.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in FP&A, manufacturing, warehousing, logistics finance, business operations, or a related analytical role.
* Strong understanding of financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, and variance analysis.
* Experience partnering directly with operational teams and translating business requirements into financial insights.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. * Analyse company financial statements, business models, earnings performance, and key financial metrics.
* Monitor equity markets, economic developments, industry trends, and company-specific events.
* Build and maintain financial models to support valuation and investment analysis.
* Prepare company research reports, investment summaries, and market updates for internal review.
* Conduct valuation analysis using relevant methodologies and financial market data.
* Track portfolio companies and provide regular updates on earnings, corporate actions, and material developments.
* Support due diligence and research activities for potential investment opportunities.

* Experience with financial modelling and valuation techniques such as DCF and comparable company analysis.
* Strong analytical, quantitative, research, and written communication skills.
* Good attention to detail and ability to work with financial and market data.
* Proficient in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; experience with financial research platforms will be an advantage.
* Ability to independently research companies, industries, and investment themes.
* Good written and spoken English, with the ability to present research findings clearly.
* Experience covering Asian or global equity markets will be an advantage.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

The Quantitative Trading & Research (QTR) group is responsible for systematic trading across FX, Rates, Commodities, Credit, Equity and a wide range of markets. Within QTR, AI Market Lab brings together quantitative research, modern artificial intelligence, market microstructure, and high-performance engineering to develop the next generation of electronic trading capabilities. Our work spans signal research, pricing, market making, execution, portfolio construction, risk management, and the production systems that support them.

We are seeking an AI/ML quantitative researcher with hands-on experience pre-training large foundation models from scratch. You will lead research on building Transformer-based and time-series foundation models over large-scale market datasets, and develop the methods needed to make them robust, transferable, and measurable across instruments and regimes.

This role is designed for someone who wants to do deep research with real constraints—where questions like scaling laws, data efficiency, and robustness are not academic footnotes, but the core of the agenda.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Pre-train Transformer-based and time-series foundation models from scratch using large-scale market, order-book, transaction, and cross-asset datasets.
* Develop data representations, tokenization schemes, self-supervised objectives, model architectures, and distributed training recipes for financial time series.
* Fine-tune and post-train foundation models for alpha generation, pricing, market making, execution, and risk-management tasks.
* Study scaling laws, transfer across instruments and asset classes, regime robustness, data efficiency, and the trade-offs among model quality, inference cost, and latency.
* Design evaluation protocols that connect pre-training metrics to economically meaningful outcomes, including out-of-sample prediction, simulated trading, transaction costs, capacity, and live markouts.
* Build reusable training, checkpointing, evaluation, and model-serving components with ML infrastructure engineers.

**Required Qualifications**

* Advanced degree (Master's, PhD) in machine learning, computer science, statistics, mathematics, operations research, engineering, or a related quantitative field.
* At least 2 years of relevant experience
* Demonstrated experience pre-training a large model from scratch (Transformer/LLM/multimodal/time-series). *Experience limited to API usage or prompt engineering is not sufficient.*
* Experience building large-scale data pipelines and distributed training systems using PyTorch, JAX, or equivalent frameworks.
* Deep knowledge of large-model training and evaluation: optimization, parallelism, mixed precision, checkpointing, experiment design, ablations, and benchmarking.
* Evidence of research/technical quality through successful large-model training, high-impact research, open-source systems, or production deployment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with fine-tuning/post-training for forecasting, ranking, decision-making, or structured prediction.
* Prior work on time-series foundation models, limit-order-book modeling, multimodal market data, or cross-asset transfer learning.

Incident & Problem Management
  
  
Act as a key point of contact for SAP FICO incidents and production issues.
  
  
Analyze incidents, identify root causes and coordinate resolution with internal teams, SAP support partners and vendors.
  
  
Ensure incidents are prioritized, tracked and resolved within agreed service levels.
  
  
Identify recurring issues and drive problem management and permanent fixes, rather than relying on workarounds.
  
  
Conduct root cause analysis and recommend preventive measures.
  
  
Monitor incident trends and identify opportunities to improve system stability and support quality.
  
  
Ensure proper documentation of incidents, resolutions, known errors, and support procedures.
  
  
Continuously improve the incident management and SAP support processes.
  
  
SAP FICO Business Analysis
  
  
Provide functional expertise across SAP FI processes, particularly GL, AP, AR, Bank Accounting and Asset Accounting.
  
  
Understand business requirements and translate/package them to development teams.
  
  
Analyze existing financial processes, identify gaps and recommend system or process improvements.
  
  
Work with business users (Finance, Controlling, Accounting teams) to understand pain points and opportunities for automation.
  
  
Prepare business requirements, functional specifications, process flows and solution documentation.
  
  
Support configuration, testing and implementation of SAP FICO solutions.
  
  
Evaluate the impact of proposed changes across integrated business processes.
  
  
Ensure solutions are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with business objectives.
  
  
Project Management & Delivery
  
  
Lead or support SAP-related projects and system enhancement initiatives from requirements through implementation (approximately 60% of role scope, in line with a similar split to the SAP Logistics BA role).
  
  
Define project scope, deliverables, milestones and dependencies.
  
  
Coordinate business users, IT teams, vendors and other stakeholders.
  
  
Track project progress, risks, issues and dependencies.
  
  
Facilitate workshops, requirements gathering, solution discussions and user acceptance testing.
  
  
Coordinate testing activities, defect resolution and deployment.
  
  
Support change management, user communication and post-implementation stabilization.
  
  
Ensure projects deliver measurable business and operational benefits.
  
  
System & Process Improvement
  
  
Proactively identify opportunities to improve SAP FICO functionality, business processes and operational efficiency.
  
  
Review existing processes and challenge manual, duplicated or inefficient activities.

Work with Finance business teams to redesign processes where appropriate.
  
  
Develop business cases and recommendations for system enhancements and automation.
  
  
Measure and communicate the benefits achieved through improvements.
  
  
Maintain a continuous improvement roadmap for SAP FICO processes.
  
  
Stakeholder & Vendor Management

Act as the bridge between business requirements and technical teams.
  
  
Manage vendors to ensure timely and quality delivery of support and project outcomes.
  
  
Challenge vendors constructively on recurring incidents, solution quality and delivery timelines.
  
  
Facilitate discussions between stakeholders to reach practical and sustainable solutions.
  
  
Communicate complex SAP FICO issues in a clear and business-friendly manner.
  
  
Governance & Documentation

Support SAP release, enhancement and deployment activities.
  
  
Maintain knowledge bases, standard operating procedures and support documentation.
  
  
Ensure appropriate controls are in place for system changes and business processes, including financial controls relevant to GL/AP/AR/Fixed Assets.

jobs.title: Market Analyst
jobs.description:
Pearl Energy Resources Pte. Ltd. is seeking a highly motivated Market Analyst to support our fuel oil trading activities in Singapore and the wider Asian market.
  
  
The Market Analyst will play an important role in understanding the physical fuel oil market by monitoring global supply flows into Singapore and Asia. A key responsibility will be to track fuel oil tanker movements, cargo volumes, timing, origins, destinations, and grades, using a range of market data services, shipping intelligence, and other relevant information sources.
  
  
The successful candidate will translate this information into actionable market intelligence, providing traders with timely daily insights and helping the trading team identify changes in market dynamics, supply-demand balances, arbitrage flows, and potential trading opportunities.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Monitor and analyze global fuel oil supply flows into Singapore and Asia, with particular focus on tanker movements, cargo volumes, ETA, origin, destination, cargo size, and fuel oil grade.
  
  
Track global fuel oil flows and major exporting regions, including the Middle East, Europe, the Americas, Russia/CIS, and Asia.
  
  
Use various market data, shipping intelligence, vessel-tracking, pricing, and analytical services to build a comprehensive picture of physical market flows.
  
  
Maintain and develop internal databases and tracking tools covering:
  
  
Fuel oil tanker movements and cargoes
  
  
Import/export volumes
  
  
Vessel ETA and discharge timing
  
  
Cargo origins and destinations
  
  
Fuel oil grades and specifications
  
  
Regional supply and demand developments
  
  
Provide traders with daily market intelligence, highlighting significant changes, emerging trends, and developments that may affect Singapore fuel oil pricing and physical balances.
  
  
Monitor and analyze arbitrage flows and their potential impact on Singapore supply.
  
  
Monitor refinery operations, production changes, outages, maintenance, and other developments that could affect fuel oil availability.
  
  
Develop an understanding of the relationship between physical flows, inventories, bunker demand, refining economics, freight, and paper market pricing.
  
  
Develop independent views on the direction and dynamics of the fuel oil market, supported by quantitative data and fundamental analysis.
  
  
Translate market observations into clear and concise trading implications and actionable intelligence for traders.
  
  
Contribute to discussions on the company's trading targets, market positioning, and trading strategy.
  
  
Continuously improve internal market-monitoring processes, analytical methodologies, and data utilization.
  
  
Daily Market Intelligence
  
  
The analyst is expected to move beyond simply collecting and reporting data and develop a clear understanding of what the data means for the market and for trading.
  
  
The analyst should approach information with a healthy degree of skepticism, constantly questioning assumptions, validating data from multiple sources, and challenging conventional views in order to get to the underlying truth of what is actually happening in the market. The objective is not simply to identify what the data says, but to understand why it is happening, what may be missing or misleading, and what it means for future market direction and trading opportunities.
  
  
Candidate Profile
  
  
1–3 years of relevant experience in oil market analysis, commodity research, shipping intelligence, or ship/vessel tracking.
  
  
Experience in fuel oil, crude oil, refined products, tanker shipping, or physical commodity markets is preferred.
  
  
Experience using vessel-tracking or shipping intelligence platforms is highly desirable.
  
  
Familiarity with market data and information services such as Kpler, S&P Global Core/Platts, Argus, or equivalent platforms is an advantage.
  
  
Strong Excel skills, including the ability to organize, analyze, and interpret large datasets.
  
  
Comfortable using Claude or other AI tools to support data analysis, information gathering, research, and workflow automation.
  
  
Strong analytical and numerical skills with a high level of attention to detail.
  
  
Ability to identify patterns, anomalies, and changes in large amounts of market and shipping data.
  
  
Good understanding or strong interest in tanker shipping and physical oil flows.
  
  
Excellent communication skills and the ability to present market information clearly, concisely, and with a commercial perspective.
  
  
Ability to work closely with traders in a fast-moving and information-driven market environment.
  
  
Commercial mindset and willingness to develop independent market views.
  
  
What We Are Looking For
  
  
We are looking for someone who is curious, analytical, commercially minded, and genuinely interested in understanding physical commodity markets.
  
  
The ideal candidate will enjoy working with data and have the ability to connect information from different sources—such as vessel movements, refinery operations, freight, regional demand, arbitrage flows, inventories, and price movements—to develop a coherent view of the market.
  
  
This is not purely a reporting or research role. The Market Analyst will work closely with traders and is expected to progressively develop the ability to translate market intelligence into trading ideas and recommendations.
  
  
We are a Singapore-based independent energy trading company. Initially focused on fuel oil trading, our strategic roadmap expands across crude oil and renewable energy products.
  
  
We leverage deep industry expertise, strong market networks, and disciplined risk management to operate in niche segments often underserved by large oil majors. All trading activities are conducted exclusively on a proprietary basis.

jobs.description:
**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.**

Join an inclusive team passionate about one thing: using their expertise in the relentless pursuit of innovation for customers and partners. The solutions we build help make everything from virtual reality experiences to breakthroughs in neural networks possible. We do it all while committing to integrity, sustainability, and giving back to our communities. Because doing so can fuel the very innovation we are pursuing.

**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.**  
  
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

As part of the HIG HBM Product and System Engineering organization, you will be leading a team of engineers building the predictive models that determine how HBM is screened, dispositioned, and tested in high-volume manufacturing.

In this role, you will work on intelligent systems that improve engineering productivity, strengthen technical decision-making, and unlock insights from complex manufacturing, validation, and engineering workflows.

You will collaborate with cross-functional teams across Product and System Engineering, Design Engineering, Test Engineering, Data Science, IT, and Manufacturing to prototype, build, and scale practical AI-driven solutions that improve quality, cost, cycle time, and engineering efficiency. Also, you will need to be experienced as people leader and manager and able to lead, manage and coach a group of engineers.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Mentorship and Development:** Actively mentor and develop team members to foster growth and development within the team and the organization.
* **Team and Technical Leadership:** Lead a team of engineers, set technical direction, review modeling work with rigor, balance workload across a shifting portfolio, and hire and onboard to raise the technical bar of the team.
* **Predictive Yield and Reliability Modeling:** Own the design, training, validation, and productization of models that predict yield loss, defect escapes, and reliability risk from manufacturing and test data, applying gradient-boosted tree methods, time-series and temporal models, anomaly detection, and classical statistical methods.
* **Model Lifecycle and Drift Control:** Build and operate the deployment path, including real-time and batch inference, result storage, performance monitoring, drift detection, retraining triggers, feature change management, and rollback, ensuring training and production feature pipelines are provably identical.
* **Machine Learning Production:** Develop and productionize machine learning and deep learning models for classification, regression, anomaly detection, failure analysis, and engineering decision support.
* **Large-Scale Data Pipelines:** Develop scalable data pipelines and analytical workflows to ingest, clean, transform, and analyze large, complex, and heterogeneous datasets from multiple manufacturing and engineering systems.
* **Advanced Data Analytics:** Apply Python, SQL, and data science libraries (e.g., pandas, matplotlib) to perform deep analysis, generate visualizations, and deliver actionable engineering insights.
* **Distributed Data Processing:** Implement robust data processing techniques such as data cleansing, outlier detection, and missing-data handling using distributed or large-scale frameworks (e.g., PySpark, BigQuery).
* **Production Deployment:** Support deployment, monitoring, and operationalization of AI/ML solutions in cloud and enterprise environments.
* **GenAI and Agentic Augmentation:** Apply GenAI and agentic systems to failure triage, root-cause analysis, engineering knowledge retrieval, data extraction, code generation, and analysis automation, and use modern AI coding tools to raise team throughput.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with domain experts and cross-functional teams to translate complex engineering problems into scalable AI/ML and analytics solutions, and align with Product, Test, Yield, Process, and Fab teams on fail-mode definitions, screening conditions, disposition changes, and deployment decision-making.
* **Technical Communication:** Communicate technical findings, recommendations, and model outcomes clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* **Innovation Leadership:** Identify and drive high-impact opportunities where machine learning, advanced analytics, and GenAI can improve yield, quality, cost, cycle time, and engineering productivity.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field.
* Demonstrating Strong Leadership Skills and Technical Skills, especially in problem solving with root cause understanding and solution space.
* Dedicated and highly motivated with a flexible approach towards adapting to different roles in a dynamic working environment (from leading the team to leading technical programs).
* Minimum 5 years of hands-on machine learning, data science, or predictive-modeling experience, including at least 2 years leading a team of engineers or data scientists as a people manager or formal technical lead, setting direction, reviewing others' technical work, and developing team members.
* Demonstrated depth in gradient-boosted tree methods such as XGBoost, LightGBM, or CatBoost applied to real production problems, including feature engineering, severe class imbalance, hyperparameter tuning, probability calibration, threshold selection, and interpretability.
* Practical experience with time-series and temporal modeling, including forecasting, trend and change-point detection, rolling-window feature construction, temporal cross-validation, and distribution-drift detection.
* Track record of models running in production rather than only in notebooks, including deployment, performance monitoring, and retraining, with a clear account of at least one model whose live behavior diverged from offline results and what was done about it.
* Ability to define and defend business-level acceptance criteria for a model, translating model output into cost, yield, quality, or cycle-time terms that a manufacturing organization will act on.
* Strong programming proficiency in Python and SQL.
* Strong technical foundation in data analytics and visualization, including tools and libraries such as pandas, scikit-learn, matplotlib, plotly, or similar ecosystems.

* Experience analyzing large, complex, and heterogeneous datasets from multiple systems and applying sound techniques for data cleansing, outlier handling, and missing-data treatment.
* Cloud experience with GCP, AWS, or Azure, including deploying ML pipelines in production.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and software development skills.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts and findings effectively.

* Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and engineering rigor.
* Passionate about people leadership, with a drive toward ongoing learning and development in this area.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with semiconductor manufacturing, test, or yield data, including wafer probe and final test electrical data, inline metrology, defect inspection, fault-detection and equipment trace data, assembly and packaging data, or tool and chamber history.
* Direct experience in yield prediction or yield improvement modeling, die or wafer disposition, binning and screening rule development, DPM or reliability prediction, test-time or test-cost reduction, or excursion detection.
* Experience with memory products, advanced packaging, 3D stacking, or heterogeneous integration.
* Deep understanding of semiconductor-specific AI/ML applications.
* Experience using enterprise data platforms such as BigQuery, Snowflake, MSSQL, Oracle, or Redshift.
* MLOps tooling and practice, including experiment tracking, feature stores, model registries, pipeline orchestration, and containerized deployment.
* Experience with Kubernetes or similar production infrastructure and deployment frameworks.
* Experience with anomaly detection, survival analysis, causal inference, uncertainty quantification, or Bayesian methods.
* Experience designing scalable, enterprise-grade AI/ML systems with attention to reliability, traceability, reproducibility, and operational readiness.

* Experience building agentic systems or AI solutions for semiconductor manufacturing, product engineering, validation, yield improvement, reliability, or failure analysis.
* Familiarity with agentic AI frameworks such as LangGraph, Google ADK, or AutoGen, evaluation tools such as AgentEval, and modern AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, Cline, Windsurf, or Gemini CLI.
* Experience working in cross-functional environments spanning engineering, manufacturing, data science, and IT.

We are an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions transforming how the world uses information to enrich life *for all*. With a relentless focus on our customers, technology leadership, and manufacturing and operational excellence, Micron delivers a rich portfolio of high-performance DRAM, NAND, and NOR memory and storage products through our Micron® and Crucial® brands. Job Description:

**Job Purpose**

The Business Continuity Organization (BCO) Analyst provides guidance on business continuity and disaster recovery planning and testing activities in accordance with Intercontinental Exchange’s (ICE) global policy, governance, and standards. Responds at time of disaster to assist Risk Management run the Emergency Operations Center.

The Business Continuity Organization (BCO) Analyst plays a critical role in protecting the operational resilience of ICE's global exchanges, clearing houses, and data distribution services. This role supports the development, maintenance, and execution of Business Continuity (BC) across ICE's portfolio of regulated financial market infrastructures.

The BCO Analyst will preferably have knowledge and understanding of business continuity, emergency management, and/or incident/crisis response to support ICE's business continuity program.

The BCO Analyst operates within the Service Reliability department and works across 13 business segments supporting 80+ businesses. This position requires a blend of risk management acumen, incident coordination experience, and analytical discipline. The analyst must be equally comfortable supporting continuity plans, exercises, and live incident response, often under time pressure.

**Responsibilities**

* BIA Execution & Plan Maintenance
  + Update / maintain, and continuously improve BC plans in alignment with ICE regulatory frameworks
  + Support the execution of Business Impact Analyses (BIAs) to identify critical processes, recovery time objectives (RTOs), and critical dependencies
  + Maintain BIA and plan documentation in ServiceNow and other platforms, ensuring version control and stakeholder accessibility
* Incident & Crisis Management
  + Engage in the Location Incident Management lifecycle - exploring Everbridge mass notifications disbursement, and Location Incident Management Team exercises and plan maintenance
  + Contribute to the BCO Incident Quick Open (IQO) process and maintain incident classification taxonomy aligned to ServiceNow
* Risk Assessment & Reporting
  + Assist in gathering data for the Location Risk Assessments for each facility
* Testing & Exercises
  + Document exercise outcomes, gap findings, and corrective action items; track remediation through closure
  + Train and educate stakeholders on incident response, BC procedures, and program updates
* Cross-Functional Collaboration
  + Partner with portfolio managers to gain comprehensive knowledge of business operations and provide alternate support to ensure continuity in the event of a disruption
  + Coordinate with Enterprise Risk Management, Internal Audit, Regulatory Relations, and Compliance stakeholders on BCO program governance and oversight activities

**Knowledge and Experience**

* 3+ years of experience in business continuity, disaster recovery, risk management, emergency management, or IT operations, preferably within financial services or a regulated industry
* Demonstrated experience with business continuity and incident management platforms such as ServiceNow, Everbridge, PagerDuty, or similar tools
* Familiarity with Business Continuity frameworks and best practices including ISO 22301
* Relevant certifications from BCI or DRII, such as the ABCP or similar certification is a plus
* Bachelor’s degree or the equivalent combination of education, training, and work experience
* Scheduling flexibility is required, as this role supports a 24/7 operating environment and may require occasional after-hours response and support
* Technical Skills
  + Proficiency with incident management and ITSM tools (ServiceNow, PagerDuty, Everbridge, or equivalents)
  + Ability to analyze and document operational workflows, data flows, and system interdependencies
  + Comfortable working with data in Microsoft office suite or similar tools for reporting, analysis, and tracking
* Analytical Skills
  + Strong problem-solving and root-cause analysis skills
  + Attention to detail when reviewing plans, procedures, and compliance documentation
* Communication & Collaboration
  + Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate risks, issues, and status updates to stakeholders
  + Calm and effective under pressure; proven ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders during active incidents
  + Team-oriented with the initiative to work independently and drive tasks to completion

**Preferred Knowledge and Experience**

* Experience within financial exchanges, clearing houses, or data distribution environments
* Exposure to regulators such as CFTC, SEC, or similar regulatory bodies

jobs.description:
Job Description:

**Job Purpose**

The primary purpose of this position is to research, analyze, interpret, transform and present reference data for Equity and Funds securities across Global markets. The focus of this position is to perform this work with documents in English, Vietnamese and other APAC languages.

The incumbent must successfully complete a two-month training program that centers on building enough subject matter expertise and the utilization of the database(s) of record such that the incumbent can independently analyze legal and financial documents associated with Equity and Fund securities. During training, the incumbent must master all the subject matter and will be required to pass a series of quizzes and tests as well achieve the accuracy and timeliness metrics that were established for trainees.

The training curriculum for the Data Analyst contains high level overviews of the complex structures worked on by more senior personnel as well as reference data client use cases so that the incumbent can differentiate between legal and financial language that is relevant to and required by our client base versus jargon describing information that is not required and, so that the incumbent can identify new financing techniques that come to market. The incumbent must then apply this foundation of knowledge via a logical sequence of decision-making events to determine relevancy of said information to our clients for any of their use cases and if deemed relevant, determine the appropriate next steps to ensure high client satisfaction levels.

The Equity and Funds asset class consists of significantly large volumes of active securities and the reference data provided by ICE Data Services for said securities is used by our clients to make trading decisions, settle trades, make investment decisions, manage portfolios, analyze risk, create security master files, create client statements and conduct other back-office functions. Our reference data is also used by internal stakeholders such as the Evaluated Pricing, Index and Analytics groups said reference data plays an integral role in determining evaluated prices, determining whether or not a security should be added to or deleted from an index or indices, the weighted average of a security within an index and, performing a series of analytical calculations that are used both internally within Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) and externally by these stakeholder’s clientele.

**Responsibilities**

* Analyze, interpret, collate and transform reference data for simple structures/events in either the primary market or the secondary market (but not both) provided in a variety legal and financial documents, third party reports and vendor information while ensuring that the reference data provided in ICE’s products and services accurate, comprehensive and in a timely manner, namely best in class with oversight from senior members of the team.
* Own end-to-end equity reference data lifecycle: onboarding of new securities, data maintenance, change management, and archival.
* Manage corporate actions impacts on reference data (splits, name changes, mergers, spin-offs).
* Operate robust SLAs for timeliness, completeness, and data quality; drive near‑real‑time updates where applicable.
* Ability to use ML/NLP/LLM techniques with a human-in-the-loop approach to delivery high accurate, timely securities data to downstream teams.
* Make sound, subjective decisions when interpreting legal and financial information by utilizing subject matter expertise to infer, deduce and ultimately draw the right conclusions.
* Procure required documents and/or trusted content utilizing creative internet searches and by conducting direct outreach to issuers, underwriters, fiduciary agents and bond counsel.
* Provide customer support in conjunction with the DSG team for users of ICE products by resolving inquiries in a timely manner and conducting additional analysis.
* Help identify trends and causations of inaccurate and/or incomplete data including but not limited to staying current with new financing techniques used by the marketplace and organizations that impact coverage and completeness.
* Research new market initiatives, regulatory updates, technological developments, and competitive trends, and communicate insights to relevant stakeholders—such as Product, Sales, and Business teams—in a timely, structured, and accurate manner.
* Apply problem-solving skills to identify and help to resolve data quality issues and/or work-flow inefficiencies and process improvements resulting in increased accuracy levels, time to market and productivity.
* Participate in ad hoc projects to optimize processes and/or improve the quality of the data set.
* Communicate with and influence market participants including underwriters, issuers, trust administrators and exchanges through phone and email correspondence to procure required reference data content, resolve data discrepancies and gain an understanding of undefined terms.

**Knowledge and Experience**

* This role requires Fluency in English and proficiency in Vietnamese is an advantage, as this role involves occasional communication with stakeholders whose primary working language is Vietnamese.
* MBA/BS in Finance, Economics or equivalent practical experience
* 0-2+ years of relevant work experience from outside the organization directly working in reference data operations or customer service; 2+ years relevant experience is preferred
* Reviewing issuer sites, exchange notices, and regulatory documents
* Ability to work in a fast paced, high pressured, fluid environment
* Ability to distill large amounts of varied information into specific takeaways
* Excellent attention to detail and high degree of demonstrated decision-making and problem-solving skills
* Strong analytical skills
* Eagerness to learn and collaborate with others
* Strong excel skills required
